headline: Toshi Kawashima's profile dates an Apple DMS verification role to October 2018
fact: Toshi Kawashima's public professional profile dates the start of his Apple role as Manager, DMS (Digital Mixed-Signal) Design Verification to October 2018 and says he leads a team responsible for DMS and AMS verification and methodology work across mixed-signal LSI projects.

sources.title: Toshi Kawashima — LinkedIn
sources.summary: Kawashima's public professional profile dates his Apple DMS design-verification manager role to October 2018 and describes the team's verification and methodology responsibilities.
